metadata.question: Was there at least 35 millimeters of rain in areas of Wales and central and southern England on January 2, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need precipitation data for January 2, 2024 - Location: Wales and central/southern England - GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) or ERA5 for daily precipitation - GPM IMERG Daily provides daily precipitation totals 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data - Need to check if precipitation >= 35mm in the region 3. Logic: - Valid data: Check if we have data for the date - If max precipitation in the region >= 35mm → A (Yes) - If max precipitation < 35mm → B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // Define region: Wales and central/southern England const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-5.5, 49.9], [-5.5, 53.5], [2.0, 53.5], [2.0, 49.9], [-5.5, 49.9]] ]); // Get GPM IMERG Daily precipitation for January 2, 2024 const date = '2024-01-02'; const collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(date, '2024-01-03') .filterBounds(region) .select('precipitation'); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data available for this date'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the image (GPM provides half-hourly, sum to daily) const dailyPrecip = collection.sum(); // Check pixel count const countResult = dailyPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = countResult.precipitation || 0; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in region'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Get statistics for the region const stats = dailyPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxPrecip = stats.precipitation_max; const meanPrecip = stats.precipitation_mean; console.log(`Max precipitation: ${maxPrecip ? maxPrecip.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); console.log(`Mean precipitation: ${meanPrecip ? meanPrecip.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); if (maxPrecip === null || maxPrecip === undefined || isNaN(maxPrecip)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if any area received >= 35mm if (maxPrecip >= 35.0) { console.log('At least one area received >= 35mm of rain'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No areas received >= 35mm of rain'); console.log('B'); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
